stories.title: Judge rejects DOJ bid to break up Google's ad tech business
stories.description: The ruling marks the third consecutive failed attempt by federal antitrust enforcers to force a Big Tech company to divest assets.

stories.title: Iran seizes fuel-smuggling ship in Gulf, arrests 11 crew
stories.description: The seizure follows Iran's detention of a bulk carrier for dumping oil waste into the Strait of Hormuz, as Tehran steps up maritime enforcement.

stories.title: US strikes Iranian tankers under new 'tanker for tanker' policy
stories.description: Trump approved retaliatory strikes on two Iranian oil tankers and roughly 100 military targets near the Strait of Hormuz on Tuesday.

stories.title: Xi, Sisi hold Cairo talks to deepen China-Egypt ties
stories.description: The leaders met Wednesday during Xi's first Egypt visit in a decade, with both sides targeting $25 billion in bilateral trade by year's end.

stories.title: NYC bans AI for 600,000 students through 8th grade
stories.description: The nation's largest school district is imposing a one-year moratorium on generative AI for pre-K through middle school, along with strict new screen time limits.

stories.title: Trump aides push to keep Iran war quiet until midterms
stories.description: Vice President Vance and Secretary of State Rubio back limiting escalation before November, with plans to reassess military action after the vote.

stories.title: Zelenskyy warns airlines Russian skies are unsafe amid surging drone war
stories.description: Putin called the warning "state terrorism" as both sides exchanged threats and Russia launched 174 drones at Ukraine overnight.

stories.title: USS Abraham Lincoln docks in Thailand after record 250 days at sea
stories.description: The carrier's nearly 5,000 crew members began shore leave in Pattaya after an unprecedented deployment extended by the Iran conflict.

stories.title: US allies push back on tariffs, currency move at G20
stories.description: European and Canadian officials openly criticized Trump administration trade and currency policies at the G20 finance ministers meeting in Asheville.

stories.title: US presses NATO allies to accelerate defense readiness amid Russian hybrid attacks
stories.description: Leaked intelligence suggests Russia could strike a NATO nation sooner than expected, as drone attacks and sabotage incidents escalate across Europe.

stories.title: Tyler Robinson to stand trial for Charlie Kirk killing
stories.description: Robinson, 23, pleaded not guilty to aggravated murder after a Utah judge ruled prosecutors can pursue the death penalty.

stories.title: Carney tells Trump to 'stop doing memes' and get serious on trade
stories.description: Canada's prime minister said talks can resume once Washington drops social media taunts and gets serious about negotiations.

stories.title: Zelenskyy says Ukraine paused strikes on Moscow at U.S. request
stories.description: Ukraine honored a U.S. request to suspend strikes on Moscow and St. Petersburg in late August to support diplomatic contacts, Zelenskyy revealed.

stories.title: House censures Rep. Chuck Edwards over conduct with female staffers
stories.description: The 413-2 vote made the North Carolina Republican the rare lawmaker formally rebuked by a chamber his own party controls.

stories.title: Lindsay Clancy jury reports deadlock; judge orders deliberations to continue
stories.description: After roughly 18 hours of deliberation, jurors said they cannot reach a unanimous verdict. They will return Wednesday morning.

stories.title: Greer says 'no negotiations' with Canada as tariff deadline looms
stories.description: The U.S. trade representative dismissed urgency to restart talks, with Canada's retaliatory tariffs on over 700 American products set to take effect Sept. 8.

stories.title: Vance defends Carlson ties at Jewish GOP gathering in Vegas
stories.description: The vice president condemned antisemitism but declined to repudiate Tucker Carlson during a closed-door session with the Republican Jewish Coalition.

stories.title: US pushes hands-off approach to AI regulations at G20
stories.description: The Trump administration opened a two-day tech ministerial in Chapel Hill, pressing G20 nations to avoid creating new AI oversight bodies.

stories.title: China demands rights in Venezuela after U.S. firm takes over oilfields
stories.description: Beijing pushed back after NABEP, backed by Washington, was granted control of 17 Venezuelan oilfields previously run by Chinese and Russian companies.

stories.title: House passes funding bill, averting shutdown before midterms
stories.description: The continuing resolution, which funds the government through Dec. 11, now heads to President Trump, who is expected to sign it.

stories.title: Erdogan signals new nuclear plant projects with Russia
stories.description: Turkey's president said the two countries will pursue additional power plants beyond the nearly completed Akkuyu facility on the Mediterranean coast.

stories.title: Iran says it has enough reserves after Bessent warns of economic collapse
stories.description: Iran's central bank governor vowed to inject $2 billion to stabilize markets, calling U.S. collapse warnings "psychological warfare."

stories.title: Israel arrests Hamas security chief in Gaza raid
stories.description: Airstrikes covering the operation killed at least four Palestinians, including two children, as the U.S.-backed ceasefire remains under strain.

stories.title: Two Saudi oil tankers hit by projectiles in Strait of Hormuz
stories.description: The near-simultaneous strikes late Monday escalated tensions as the U.S. and Iran exchanged fire for the first time since late July.

stories.title: Xi urges 'universal security' at SCO summit in Bishkek
stories.description: Leaders from China, Russia, India and other Eurasian nations gathered for the bloc's 25th anniversary amid overlapping global conflicts.

stories.title: USPS whistleblower warns mail ballot system risks 'catastrophic failure'
stories.description: A 20-page complaint released by Sen. Blumenthal describes the agency's new ballot IT system as rushed and unreliable, as courts weigh blocking the rule.

stories.title: Nepal-China flood death toll passes 1,000 with thousands still missing
stories.description: More than 4,400 people remain unaccounted for six days after a glacial collapse sent a wall of ice and rock through Himalayan valleys.

stories.title: Bessent tells Russia no relief until Ukraine war ends
stories.description: The Treasury secretary met with his Russian counterpart at the G20 in Asheville, marking a rare direct exchange between Washington and Moscow.

stories.title: Yemen warns Houthi-al-Qaeda ties could spread terror across Africa
stories.description: Yemen's military spokesman says the alliance is "already transnational" and could transfer drone and missile expertise to al-Qaeda affiliates in Africa.

stories.title: Ex-gang leader found guilty in Tupac Shakur murder
stories.description: Duane "Keffe D" Davis faces up to life in prison after a Las Vegas jury convicted him of first-degree murder in the 1996 drive-by killing.

stories.title: Army Secretary Driscoll resigns after months of friction with Hegseth
stories.description: Driscoll's departure leaves the Army without a Senate-confirmed civilian leader as it faces growing threats in the Middle East.

stories.title: CDC excludes Pennsylvania measles deaths from national tally amid political clash
stories.description: The agency says it is still reviewing two fatalities reported by the state, as the U.S. logs its worst measles surge in over three decades.

stories.title: Europeans protest Russia's return to G20 finance meeting in North Carolina
stories.description: European officials threatened to boycott the group photo and confronted Russia's finance minister over the Ukraine war at the U.S.-hosted summit.

stories.title: Trump calls nuclear weapon question 'stupid' after US resumes Iran strikes
stories.description: The president rejected the idea of using nuclear weapons against Iran, saying it was militarily defeated and there was "no reason for it."

stories.title: Vance rallies with Rogers as El-Sayed courts Jewish Democrats in Michigan
stories.description: Vice President JD Vance joined Republican Senate nominee Mike Rogers at a Sterling Heights event as Democrat Abdul El-Sayed apologized over synagogue attack remarks.

stories.title: FTC sues Amazon over alleged ad price manipulation
stories.description: The agency claims Amazon secretly inflated ad costs over seven years, backed by more than 20 state attorneys general.

stories.title: China demands US prove AI oversight before talks
stories.description: Beijing says Washington must show its AI firms face the same safety and audit rules before September negotiations can proceed.

stories.title: Bessent meets Russian delegation at G20 to push Trump's Ukraine peace plan
stories.description: The U.S. Treasury secretary held talks with a Russian group including Sergey Lavrov at the G20 Finance Ministerial in Asheville, North Carolina.

stories.title: Kalshi issues first-ever lifetime ban to George Santos
stories.description: The prediction market platform also fined Santos $71,356 after federal regulators found he manipulated bets on his State of the Union attendance.

stories.title: Putin chose to escalate Ukraine war, The Economist reports
stories.description: Sources say the Russian president fears ending the war without capturing Donbas could endanger his life, telling associates, "They will hang me."

stories.title: Trump urges US to 'let Data Reign,' warns towns opposing data centers
stories.description: The president's strongest defense yet of AI infrastructure comes as data center backlash emerges as a key midterm election issue.

stories.title: Taliban offers US access to Afghanistan's mineral wealth
stories.description: Foreign Minister Muttaqi told the Financial Times that Kabul would welcome American investment in mining, infrastructure and trade.

stories.title: 'Functional unemployment' hits 24.9% even as official jobless rate falls
stories.description: The Ludwig Institute says nearly 1 in 4 U.S. workers is functionally unemployed, a fourth straight monthly increase that contrasts with the Fed's rosy outlook.

stories.title: GOP anxiety grows as Talarico outspends Paxton 7-to-1 in Texas Senate race
stories.description: Democrats have dominated Texas airwaves since June while MAGA Inc. sits on its $400 million war chest, leaving Paxton financially stranded.

stories.title: Venezuela oil deal draws fire from opposition and government allies alike
stories.description: Edmundo González warned Sunday that revenues from the U.S.-Venezuela oil agreement risk benefiting only "some" rather than all citizens.

stories.title: Trump says NBC's Welker will be reported to FCC
stories.description: The president accused the "Meet the Press" host of misrepresenting his endorsement record, seeking her "rebuke or punishment."

stories.title: Pentagon to take 35% stake in Venezuela oil venture
stories.description: The Defense Department plans to invest in a private company granted 100-year rights to develop 17 Venezuelan oil fields holding 65 billion barrels.

stories.title: Iceland votes against resuming EU membership talks
stories.description: Voters rejected the proposal 52.5% to 47.5%, settling the question for a second time after accession talks were abandoned in 2015.

stories.title: NBC News crew and Palestinian woman beaten by masked Israeli settlers in West Bank
stories.description: Netanyahu condemned the attack in Jalud as Israeli security forces said they confiscated settler vehicles and opened a police investigation.

stories.title: Man charged with arson after setting himself on fire in NYC Google building
stories.description: John Butch, 63, allegedly used lighter fluid to self-immolate Friday in the lobby of a Lower Manhattan building housing Google and NYPD offices.

stories.title: DHS deports pro-deportation commentator Yiannopoulos to UK
stories.description: The far-right British provocateur, who called for ICE checkpoints and mass deportations, was himself removed after overstaying his visa since 2019.

stories.title: Crockett declines to campaign with Talarico in Texas Senate race
stories.description: The congresswoman told CNN she will focus on down-ballot candidates, declining to join the Democratic nominee who defeated her in the March primary.

stories.title: NPS endorses Trump's arch despite harm to 36 DC landmarks
stories.description: A 133-page report found the proposed 250-foot gilded arch would disrupt sightlines across Washington but called its Memorial Circle site irreplaceable.

stories.title: Hegseth weighs summoning military leaders to Quantico again
stories.description: The defense secretary could use a second large-scale gathering to announce new directives, according to the Wall Street Journal.

stories.title: US sanctions Egyptian bank's UAE branches over Iran ties
stories.description: Treasury moved to cut Banque Misr's six UAE branches from the U.S. financial system, calling them a "critical node" for Iranian dollar access.

stories.title: Judge blocks Trump deportation of pro-Palestinian students
stories.description: A federal judge ruled that two immigration law provisions used to target noncitizen students over pro-Palestinian speech violate the First and Fifth Amendments.

stories.title: Fed Chair Warsh signals rate hikes may be needed as inflation stays elevated
stories.description: In his Jackson Hole debut, Warsh said underlying inflation trends have not "meaningfully improved" and current rates may not be restricting growth.

stories.title: Pakistan says it won't comply with US sanctions on Iran
stories.description: Islamabad joins Beijing in rejecting Washington's "Operation Economic Outcast," vowing to continue and expand trade with Tehran.

stories.title: Trump administration quietly pushing to give Yosemite land to private developer
stories.description: A NOTUS investigation found the National Park Service has spent over a year working to cede a strip of parkland to a Nevada real estate firm.

stories.title: Norway's King Harald V dies at 89 after weeks in hospital
stories.description: Europe's oldest reigning monarch died peacefully Friday morning at Oslo University Hospital after battling a bacterial blood infection.

stories.title: Venezuela weighs leaving OPEC as US oil ties deepen
stories.description: A founding member of the 65-year-old cartel is in talks with Washington about a departure that would mark the second exit in months.

stories.title: Trump asks Supreme Court to allow discharge of transgender troops
stories.description: The DOJ filed a petition Friday seeking to overturn lower court rulings that block the Pentagon from removing about 4,200 transgender service members.

stories.title: FDA approves updated COVID vaccines targeting XFG variant
stories.description: Shots from Moderna, Pfizer-BioNTech, and Novavax-Sanofi are approved for older adults and high-risk individuals ahead of fall.

stories.title: New York AG sues last sheriff defying state's ICE ban
stories.description: Attorney General Letitia James filed suit Thursday against Rensselaer County's sheriff for refusing to end his office's cooperation agreement with ICE.

stories.title: Federal judge blocks Trump's bid to erase hush money conviction for third time
stories.description: Judge Hellerstein ruled Trump's presidential immunity arguments were "neither new nor legally sufficient" to move the case to federal court.

stories.title: FAA moves to fire two controllers who left early before fatal LaGuardia crash
stories.description: Two air traffic controllers departed about an hour before their shifts ended on the night of the deadly March 22 collision.

stories.title: OpenAI, Anthropic lead 100+ firms in AI cyber threat warning
stories.description: The open letter urges governments and businesses to treat cyber defense as an immediate priority before AI-powered attacks overwhelm critical infrastructure.

stories.title: Trump admin drafts rule to block China's remote AI chip access
stories.description: The Commerce Department could share the proposed export control with industry groups as early as September, though legal hurdles loom.

stories.title: Documents contradict RFK Jr.'s claim Samoa trip was unrelated to vaccines
stories.description: Letters show Kennedy wrote Samoa's prime minister proposing to study MMR vaccines before his 2019 visit, despite telling senators the trip had "nothing to do with vaccines."

stories.title: Iran war's drain on US weapons stockpiles alarms Asian allies
stories.description: Six months into the conflict, dwindling Patriot and Tomahawk missile supplies are raising fears about U.S. readiness for a potential confrontation with China.

stories.title: Judge declines to block Trump's new birthright order
stories.description: The ruling allows the administration to implement a revised executive order issued after the Supreme Court struck down its earlier attempt.

stories.title: Hamas agrees to surrender weapons in historic first, Board of Peace says
stories.description: The group accepted a 15-point roadmap for full disarmament and governance transfer, but Israel's rejection has stalled implementation.

stories.title: Four EU states urge Brussels to unlock frozen Russian assets for Ukraine
stories.description: Sweden, the Netherlands, Spain, and Poland sent a letter calling on the European Commission to restart work on using over €200 billion in frozen Russian funds.

stories.title: Judge blocks Pentagon's blacklisting of Anthropic
stories.description: The ruling found the Trump administration's supply-chain risk designation violated the AI company's First and Fifth Amendment rights.

stories.title: Second tanker hit by projectile in Strait of Hormuz this week
stories.description: Qatar's PM heads to Tehran for de-escalation talks as attacks on shipping intensify in the contested waterway six months into the U.S.-Iran war.

stories.title: Nvidia agrees to buy Hugging Face for $12.9 billion
stories.description: The deal for the open-source AI model platform would be one of the chipmaker's largest acquisitions amid an aggressive dealmaking spree.

stories.title: Most people arrested by ICE in July had no criminal record, data shows
stories.description: Federal data reveals ICE averaged over 1,580 arrests daily in July, with more than half involving people with no criminal history.

stories.title: Secret Service places 3 officials on leave amid misconduct probe
stories.description: The agency's communications chief and two colleagues lost their security clearances as the Office of Professional Responsibility investigates undisclosed allegations.

stories.title: Haiti gang threatens to kill 50 hostages after Kenscoff massacre
stories.description: A gang leader posted a video Wednesday showing captives and warning they would be executed if security forces continue operations.

stories.title: Trump DOJ raises doubts about prosecuting Fauci for contempt of Congress
stories.description: Administration officials question whether the legal strategy behind the Senate's contempt referral is strong enough to support an indictment.

stories.title: Nvidia shares rally after Q2 revenue doubles, topping estimates
stories.description: CEO Jensen Huang said AI has reached an "inflection point" as the chipmaker posted $96.2 billion in quarterly revenue and guided above consensus.

stories.title: Appeals court rules Rep. McIver must face assault trial
stories.description: A divided Third Circuit panel found the Speech or Debate Clause does not shield McIver from charges tied to a confrontation at a Newark detention facility.

stories.title: Trump admin proposes treating billion-dollar firms as small businesses
stories.description: The rule would raise size thresholds dramatically, allowing companies with up to $1 billion in revenue to access federal contracts and loans reserved for small firms.

stories.title: FDA approves first drug targeting genetic driver of pancreatic cancer
stories.description: Rasonque, made by Revolution Medicines, nearly doubled survival time in trials and was approved 6.5 months ahead of schedule.

stories.title: DHS admits its noncitizen voter roll figures were inflated
stories.description: After claiming nearly 16,000 noncitizens were on Nevada's rolls, DHS provided a list of just 185 and declined to share supporting data.

stories.title: Cook's lawyer says no grounds for Trump to fire Fed governor
stories.description: Attorney Abbe David Lowell called mortgage fraud allegations "unfounded and untrue" in a letter sent to the White House on Wednesday.

stories.title: Bill Gates warns 'there is no plan' for AI upheaval in new essay
stories.description: The Microsoft co-founder calls for global regulation, new institutions and an AI tax, warning of mass job loss and rising security threats.

stories.title: Same-name challenger advances to Alaska Senate general election
stories.description: Dan J. Sullivan, a retired teacher, secured a spot alongside incumbent Sen. Dan Sullivan and Democrat Mary Peltola in November's ranked-choice contest.

stories.title: DeSantis calls Flock cameras 'out of control' amid bipartisan revolt
stories.description: Over 100 cities have dropped Flock Safety's license plate readers as lawmakers push federal legislation to curb AI-powered surveillance.

stories.title: Trump says Iran's Khamenei alive but 'very seriously wounded'
stories.description: The president offered his most detailed assessment of the Iranian Supreme Leader, who has not been seen publicly since the February strikes that killed his father.

stories.title: Dolly Parton, queen of country music, dies at 80
stories.description: The singer-songwriter, actress and entrepreneur who rose from rural Tennessee poverty to global stardom died Tuesday, her family said.

stories.title: Anthropic to pitch $30T market opportunity ahead of IPO
stories.description: The Claude maker is preparing to tell investors its addressable market exceeds $30 trillion as it targets an October listing valued at $2 trillion.

stories.title: Trump administration pauses visa appointments worldwide
stories.description: The State Department cited a "global training initiative" for consular officers, days after a judge struck down a 75-country visa ban.

stories.title: China vows to fight back after US sanctions Chinese entities over Iran ties
stories.description: Beijing warned it will take "all necessary measures" to protect its interests after Washington sanctioned over 60 entities in its "Operation Economic Outcast" campaign.

stories.title: Ukraine stages world's first drone-only military parade
stories.description: Unmanned ground vehicles, naval drones, and aerial systems replaced soldiers on Kyiv's streets to mark 35 years of independence.

stories.title: Darline Graham wins SC GOP Senate runoff, validating Trump endorsement
stories.description: Graham defeated Rep. Ralph Norman on Tuesday despite debate gaffe concerns, and will face a Democrat in November as the heavy favorite.

stories.title: US declines to join 50-nation UN rebuke of Russia over Ukraine strikes
stories.description: Washington again broke with allies, calling on "both sides" to negotiate instead of condemning Russian aggression at a Security Council session.

stories.title: Grocers sue NYC over city-run supermarket plan
stories.description: The Multicultural Business Coalition filed two lawsuits Monday to block Mayor Mamdani's $70 million plan for five government-owned grocery stores.

stories.title: Trump sends Saudi nuclear deal to Congress, ties it to Israel recognition
stories.description: The 30-year pact, reached in July, would allow U.S. exports of civilian nuclear technology to the kingdom, including AP1000 reactors.

stories.title: EU approves $7.1 billion in defense aid for Ukraine
stories.description: The funding, announced on Ukraine's Independence Day, targets air defense systems, missiles, ammunition, and radars as Russian aerial attacks intensify.

stories.title: Iran threatens fines, detention for ships violating Hormuz transit rules
stories.description: The warning from Tehran's new maritime authority escalates tensions as the U.S. prepares to roll out sweeping new sanctions against Iran on Monday.

stories.title: US intel warned Trump killing Khamenei would backfire, WSJ reports
stories.description: Six months into the Iran conflict, a Wall Street Journal investigation reveals intelligence officials cautioned Trump the operation could empower a more extreme regime.

stories.title: Florida start-up making low-cost drone interceptors for the Iran war
stories.description: Powerus is producing its Guardian interceptor locally in the Emirates to fill gaps in allied air defenses as the U.S.-Iran war drains American-made stockpiles.

stories.title: Over 200 Chinese vessels mass near Philippine reef as Beijing announces live-fire drills
stories.description: Satellite imagery shows fishing boats in militia-like formations at Mischief Reef, raising fears of a move on Second Thomas Shoal.

stories.title: Nevada sues to block Trump administration's Colorado River cuts
stories.description: The lawsuit, the first legal challenge to the plan finalized Friday, alleges cuts of up to 71% to Nevada's allocation could devastate Las Vegas.

stories.title: Zelenskyy denies Ukraine role in Nord Stream blasts
stories.description: The Ukrainian president spoke after a second Ukrainian suspect was arrested in Croatia over the 2022 pipeline sabotage.

stories.title: Syria set to leave U.S. terrorism sponsor list after 47 years
stories.description: Congress's 45-day review period expired Saturday without opposition, clearing the way for formal removal pending Federal Register publication.

stories.title: Trump plans to revoke 200,000 visas from asylum seekers
stories.description: The move would be the largest single visa revocation in U.S. history, targeting those who entered on tourist or business visas.

stories.title: Iran urges Qatar to move detained pilots to hospital on land
stories.description: Tehran claims the airmen are being held on water in poor condition, but Qatar denies holding any surviving pilots.

stories.title: FDA urges recall of alfalfa sprouts tied to E. coli outbreak in 15 states
stories.description: At least 55 people have been sickened and four hospitalized in a dual E. coli and salmonella outbreak linked to a Minnesota sprout grower.

stories.title: Trump threatens to double tariffs on Canadian autos to 50% in January
stories.description: The announcement escalates a trade war with Ottawa days after bilateral negotiations collapsed, with Canada vowing to retaliate "dollar for dollar."

stories.title: Supreme Court lets White House ballroom construction continue
stories.description: Chief Justice Roberts froze a lower court order that would have halted the $400 million project at midnight, buying time for the justices to review the case.

stories.title: Cuba says US sanctions undercut the economic reforms Washington long demanded
stories.description: Havana's UN ambassador questioned why Washington keeps escalating penalties even as Cuba opens its economy to private investment and foreign business.

stories.title: Trump disclosure reveals 1,000 stock trades in June
stories.description: A filing released Friday shows the president sold Meta shares and bought Berkshire Hathaway amid a broad portfolio reshuffling.

stories.title: NATO's eastern allies offer to cover US base costs amid troop review
stories.description: Frontline states are preparing a cost-sharing bid ahead of a meeting with a Pentagon official next week, hoping to keep American forces in the region.

stories.title: Texas court cuts Alex Jones' Sandy Hook verdict from $50M to $1.5M
stories.description: The appeals court found the trial judge improperly let damages exceed the state's $750,000 statutory cap on exemplary damages.

stories.title: Trump warns Democrats will impeach him if GOP loses midterms
stories.description: At a South Carolina rally Friday, the president urged Republicans to treat November's elections as a referendum on his presidency.

stories.title: Vance says US moving up to 15M barrels daily through Hormuz despite Iran blockade
stories.description: The vice president said a military-protected shipping corridor is preventing the energy crisis Iran is trying to create.

stories.title: New York Times ordered to pay $9.25M in landmark defamation verdict
stories.description: An Alabama jury found the Times defamed former walk-on player Kai Spears, marking the paper's first U.S. defamation trial loss in over 50 years.

stories.title: Trump administration dismisses a dozen Fannie Mae executives
stories.description: Several top officials, including the chief economist and multifamily COO, were fired Wednesday as AI was cited as a factor in the cuts.

stories.title: Hong Kong convicts Tiananmen vigil leaders of subversion
stories.description: Lee Cheuk-yan and Chow Hang-tung were found guilty of inciting subversion for advocating an end to one-party rule in China. They face up to 10 years in prison.

stories.title: Somali pirates seize 2 ships in 4 days as hijackings hit decade high
stories.description: Six ships and over 100 crew members are now held captive as naval forces stretched by Middle East conflicts leave Somali waters less patrolled.

stories.title: Trump moves to block BBC subpoenas of family in $10B suit
stories.description: Lawyers argue the BBC's bid to compel testimony from Ivanka Trump, Donald Trump Jr. and Jared Kushner is a "politically charged" fishing expedition.

stories.title: Wahab wins California special election despite AIPAC spending
stories.description: State Sen. Aisha Wahab defeated Melissa Hernandez to fill Rep. Eric Swalwell's vacated House seat, overcoming millions in outside spending.

stories.title: FBI arrests woman in ISIS-inspired plot to bomb N.Y. Capitol
stories.description: Jessica Bowie, 35, of Albany was charged with planning to deploy an explosive at the state Capitol to kill lawmakers, the DOJ said.

stories.title: Trump threatens $5B lawsuit against think tank over National Guard report
stories.description: CAP CEO Neera Tanden called the threatened defamation suit "baseless" and said the organization would "neither cower nor bend."

stories.title: Seven nations urge Israel to withdraw E1 settlement tenders
stories.description: The UK summoned Israel's chargé d'affaires and joined six other Western governments in calling the West Bank construction plan "unacceptable."

stories.title: China builds 'unprecedented' maritime presence east of Taiwan
stories.description: A new AMTI report says Beijing deployed law enforcement ships and hailed nearly 200 commercial vessels in the Philippine Sea since June.

stories.title: Trump administration plans $725M payment toward UN debt
stories.description: The transfer covers less than 20% of the more than $4 billion the UN says Washington owes, according to Reuters.

stories.title: FBI raids Swalwell's home, seizes devices in misconduct probe
stories.description: Agents executed search warrants at San Francisco's airport and his D.C. residence over the weekend as part of a federal sexual assault investigation.

stories.title: Bessent says Treasury buybacks could top $4B per operation
stories.description: The Treasury secretary signaled further expansion of bond repurchases a day after doubling the program, citing "very poor" liquidity in long-term debt.

stories.title: Pentagon fires Stars and Stripes editor and publisher
stories.description: The dismissals follow months of clashes over the Trump administration's efforts to exert control over the military's independent newspaper.

stories.title: Romania destroys explosive sea drone near major Black Sea gas platform
stories.description: EU chief von der Leyen called the incident "hybrid warfare" as Romania's president blamed Russia for escalating threats to critical energy infrastructure.

stories.title: Evergrande founder sentenced to life in prison by Chinese court
stories.description: Hui Ka Yan was convicted on eight charges including fraud and embezzlement after the property giant's $300 billion default shook China's economy.

stories.title: US, Japan, South Korea hold urgent talks after North Korean missile barrage
stories.description: Senior diplomats coordinated their response Friday after Pyongyang fired about 10 ballistic missiles, dismissing Trump's scaled-back military drills.

stories.title: Army phases out drone battalion in Hegseth-backed shift
stories.description: The cutting-edge unit, established in Europe in January to master drone warfare lessons from Ukraine, will revert to conventional airborne infantry.

stories.title: US envoy warns Israel-Turkey nearly reached direct military confrontation over Syria strike
stories.description: Tom Barrack said Turkish forces were unaware of incoming Israeli jets and could have scrambled fighters, risking a dangerous escalation.

stories.title: White House furor over Natalie Harp intensifies after week of damaging leaks
stories.description: A pointed remark by Sen. Jon Ossoff about Trump's ever-present aide spiraled into a national story after the West Wing's aggressive pushback backfired.

stories.title: Harry and Meghan moving back to Britain after 6 years
stories.description: The couple's children are enrolled in a British school starting in September, with the family relocating to a private home outside London.

stories.title: Ousted defense chief Fedorov calls for wartime elections in biggest challenge to Zelenskyy
stories.description: Once a close Zelenskyy ally, Mykhailo Fedorov cited a "systemic crisis of governance" and condemned corruption in a nine-minute YouTube address.

stories.title: Trump admin moves to strip ABA of law school accreditation power
stories.description: The Education Department is beginning formal proceedings to revoke the ABA's authority as the sole accreditor of the nation's law schools.

stories.title: Germany condemns Ben-Gvir, drops opposition to EU sanctions
stories.description: Berlin had previously blocked EU sanctions against the Israeli minister but now backs action after his call for nightly killings in Gaza.

stories.title: Merck, Moderna mRNA cancer vaccine succeeds in Phase 3 trial
stories.description: Intismeran, a personalized mRNA therapy, reduced melanoma recurrence when added to Keytruda, marking the first positive Phase 3 result for a neoantigen cancer treatment.

stories.title: Trump withholds mandated 2024 election interference report
stories.description: The administration has released hundreds of pages of other declassified material while keeping the congressionally required foreign interference assessment secret.

stories.title: Unitree Robotics surges 460% in Shanghai debut
stories.description: China's first publicly traded humanoid robot maker closed its first day of trading at 845 yuan, up from an IPO price of 150.8 yuan.

stories.title: Ex-Fauci adviser pleads guilty to concealing COVID-19 records
stories.description: David Morens admitted to conspiring to evade public records laws tied to pandemic research grants, including efforts to revive a controversial bat coronavirus grant.

stories.title: Navy weighs renaming carrier honoring Black WWII hero after Trump
stories.description: The Ford-class carrier CVN-81, designated USS Doris Miller during Trump's first term, may become the first carrier named for a sitting president.

stories.title: Florida primaries oust Rep. Mills, advance Trump-backed newcomers
stories.description: Redrawn congressional maps reshaped Tuesday's races, with an ethics-plagued incumbent falling and first-time candidates winning key GOP nominations.

stories.title: US sanctions ICC president in latest bid to dismantle court
stories.description: Secretary of State Rubio called the ICC "corrupt and fatally politicized" as Washington targeted the court's top judge and a senior trial lawyer.

stories.title: Trump joins Michael Cohen's radio show in public reunion
stories.description: Cohen, the star witness in Trump's 2024 hush money trial, hosted the president on his WABC program after months of quiet reconciliation.

top.title: Judge rejects DOJ bid to break up Google's ad tech business
top.description: The ruling marks the third consecutive failed attempt by federal antitrust enforcers to force a Big Tech company to divest assets.

top.title: Iran seizes fuel-smuggling ship in Gulf, arrests 11 crew
top.description: The seizure follows Iran's detention of a bulk carrier for dumping oil waste into the Strait of Hormuz, as Tehran steps up maritime enforcement.

top.title: US strikes Iranian tankers under new 'tanker for tanker' policy
top.description: Trump approved retaliatory strikes on two Iranian oil tankers and roughly 100 military targets near the Strait of Hormuz on Tuesday.

top.title: Xi, Sisi hold Cairo talks to deepen China-Egypt ties
top.description: The leaders met Wednesday during Xi's first Egypt visit in a decade, with both sides targeting $25 billion in bilateral trade by year's end.

top.title: NYC bans AI for 600,000 students through 8th grade
top.description: The nation's largest school district is imposing a one-year moratorium on generative AI for pre-K through middle school, along with strict new screen time limits.

top.title: Trump aides push to keep Iran war quiet until midterms
top.description: Vice President Vance and Secretary of State Rubio back limiting escalation before November, with plans to reassess military action after the vote.

top.title: Zelenskyy warns airlines Russian skies are unsafe amid surging drone war
top.description: Putin called the warning "state terrorism" as both sides exchanged threats and Russia launched 174 drones at Ukraine overnight.

top.title: USS Abraham Lincoln docks in Thailand after record 250 days at sea
top.description: The carrier's nearly 5,000 crew members began shore leave in Pattaya after an unprecedented deployment extended by the Iran conflict.

top.title: US allies push back on tariffs, currency move at G20
top.description: European and Canadian officials openly criticized Trump administration trade and currency policies at the G20 finance ministers meeting in Asheville.

top.title: US presses NATO allies to accelerate defense readiness amid Russian hybrid attacks
top.description: Leaked intelligence suggests Russia could strike a NATO nation sooner than expected, as drone attacks and sabotage incidents escalate across Europe.

top.title: Tyler Robinson to stand trial for Charlie Kirk killing
top.description: Robinson, 23, pleaded not guilty to aggravated murder after a Utah judge ruled prosecutors can pursue the death penalty.

top.title: Carney tells Trump to 'stop doing memes' and get serious on trade
top.description: Canada's prime minister said talks can resume once Washington drops social media taunts and gets serious about negotiations.

top.title: Zelenskyy says Ukraine paused strikes on Moscow at U.S. request
top.description: Ukraine honored a U.S. request to suspend strikes on Moscow and St. Petersburg in late August to support diplomatic contacts, Zelenskyy revealed.

top.title: House censures Rep. Chuck Edwards over conduct with female staffers
top.description: The 413-2 vote made the North Carolina Republican the rare lawmaker formally rebuked by a chamber his own party controls.

top.title: Lindsay Clancy jury reports deadlock; judge orders deliberations to continue
top.description: After roughly 18 hours of deliberation, jurors said they cannot reach a unanimous verdict. They will return Wednesday morning.

top.title: Greer says 'no negotiations' with Canada as tariff deadline looms
top.description: The U.S. trade representative dismissed urgency to restart talks, with Canada's retaliatory tariffs on over 700 American products set to take effect Sept. 8.

top.title: Vance defends Carlson ties at Jewish GOP gathering in Vegas
top.description: The vice president condemned antisemitism but declined to repudiate Tucker Carlson during a closed-door session with the Republican Jewish Coalition.

top.title: US pushes hands-off approach to AI regulations at G20
top.description: The Trump administration opened a two-day tech ministerial in Chapel Hill, pressing G20 nations to avoid creating new AI oversight bodies.

top.title: China demands rights in Venezuela after U.S. firm takes over oilfields
top.description: Beijing pushed back after NABEP, backed by Washington, was granted control of 17 Venezuelan oilfields previously run by Chinese and Russian companies.

top.title: House passes funding bill, averting shutdown before midterms
top.description: The continuing resolution, which funds the government through Dec. 11, now heads to President Trump, who is expected to sign it.

top.title: Erdogan signals new nuclear plant projects with Russia
top.description: Turkey's president said the two countries will pursue additional power plants beyond the nearly completed Akkuyu facility on the Mediterranean coast.

top.title: Iran says it has enough reserves after Bessent warns of economic collapse
top.description: Iran's central bank governor vowed to inject $2 billion to stabilize markets, calling U.S. collapse warnings "psychological warfare."

top.title: Israel arrests Hamas security chief in Gaza raid
top.description: Airstrikes covering the operation killed at least four Palestinians, including two children, as the U.S.-backed ceasefire remains under strain.

top.title: Two Saudi oil tankers hit by projectiles in Strait of Hormuz
top.description: The near-simultaneous strikes late Monday escalated tensions as the U.S. and Iran exchanged fire for the first time since late July.

top.title: Xi urges 'universal security' at SCO summit in Bishkek
top.description: Leaders from China, Russia, India and other Eurasian nations gathered for the bloc's 25th anniversary amid overlapping global conflicts.

top.title: USPS whistleblower warns mail ballot system risks 'catastrophic failure'
top.description: A 20-page complaint released by Sen. Blumenthal describes the agency's new ballot IT system as rushed and unreliable, as courts weigh blocking the rule.

top.title: Nepal-China flood death toll passes 1,000 with thousands still missing
top.description: More than 4,400 people remain unaccounted for six days after a glacial collapse sent a wall of ice and rock through Himalayan valleys.

top.title: Bessent tells Russia no relief until Ukraine war ends
top.description: The Treasury secretary met with his Russian counterpart at the G20 in Asheville, marking a rare direct exchange between Washington and Moscow.

top.title: Yemen warns Houthi-al-Qaeda ties could spread terror across Africa
top.description: Yemen's military spokesman says the alliance is "already transnational" and could transfer drone and missile expertise to al-Qaeda affiliates in Africa.

top.title: Ex-gang leader found guilty in Tupac Shakur murder
top.description: Duane "Keffe D" Davis faces up to life in prison after a Las Vegas jury convicted him of first-degree murder in the 1996 drive-by killing.

top.title: Army Secretary Driscoll resigns after months of friction with Hegseth
top.description: Driscoll's departure leaves the Army without a Senate-confirmed civilian leader as it faces growing threats in the Middle East.

top.title: CDC excludes Pennsylvania measles deaths from national tally amid political clash
top.description: The agency says it is still reviewing two fatalities reported by the state, as the U.S. logs its worst measles surge in over three decades.

top.title: Europeans protest Russia's return to G20 finance meeting in North Carolina
top.description: European officials threatened to boycott the group photo and confronted Russia's finance minister over the Ukraine war at the U.S.-hosted summit.

top.title: Trump calls nuclear weapon question 'stupid' after US resumes Iran strikes
top.description: The president rejected the idea of using nuclear weapons against Iran, saying it was militarily defeated and there was "no reason for it."

top.title: Vance rallies with Rogers as El-Sayed courts Jewish Democrats in Michigan
top.description: Vice President JD Vance joined Republican Senate nominee Mike Rogers at a Sterling Heights event as Democrat Abdul El-Sayed apologized over synagogue attack remarks.

top.title: FTC sues Amazon over alleged ad price manipulation
top.description: The agency claims Amazon secretly inflated ad costs over seven years, backed by more than 20 state attorneys general.

top.title: China demands US prove AI oversight before talks
top.description: Beijing says Washington must show its AI firms face the same safety and audit rules before September negotiations can proceed.

top.title: Bessent meets Russian delegation at G20 to push Trump's Ukraine peace plan
top.description: The U.S. Treasury secretary held talks with a Russian group including Sergey Lavrov at the G20 Finance Ministerial in Asheville, North Carolina.

top.title: Kalshi issues first-ever lifetime ban to George Santos
top.description: The prediction market platform also fined Santos $71,356 after federal regulators found he manipulated bets on his State of the Union attendance.

top.title: Putin chose to escalate Ukraine war, The Economist reports
top.description: Sources say the Russian president fears ending the war without capturing Donbas could endanger his life, telling associates, "They will hang me."

top.title: Trump urges US to 'let Data Reign,' warns towns opposing data centers
top.description: The president's strongest defense yet of AI infrastructure comes as data center backlash emerges as a key midterm election issue.

top.title: Taliban offers US access to Afghanistan's mineral wealth
top.description: Foreign Minister Muttaqi told the Financial Times that Kabul would welcome American investment in mining, infrastructure and trade.

top.title: 'Functional unemployment' hits 24.9% even as official jobless rate falls
top.description: The Ludwig Institute says nearly 1 in 4 U.S. workers is functionally unemployed, a fourth straight monthly increase that contrasts with the Fed's rosy outlook.

top.title: GOP anxiety grows as Talarico outspends Paxton 7-to-1 in Texas Senate race
top.description: Democrats have dominated Texas airwaves since June while MAGA Inc. sits on its $400 million war chest, leaving Paxton financially stranded.

top.title: Venezuela oil deal draws fire from opposition and government allies alike
top.description: Edmundo González warned Sunday that revenues from the U.S.-Venezuela oil agreement risk benefiting only "some" rather than all citizens.

top.title: Trump says NBC's Welker will be reported to FCC
top.description: The president accused the "Meet the Press" host of misrepresenting his endorsement record, seeking her "rebuke or punishment."

top.title: Pentagon to take 35% stake in Venezuela oil venture
top.description: The Defense Department plans to invest in a private company granted 100-year rights to develop 17 Venezuelan oil fields holding 65 billion barrels.

top.title: Iceland votes against resuming EU membership talks
top.description: Voters rejected the proposal 52.5% to 47.5%, settling the question for a second time after accession talks were abandoned in 2015.

top.title: NBC News crew and Palestinian woman beaten by masked Israeli settlers in West Bank
top.description: Netanyahu condemned the attack in Jalud as Israeli security forces said they confiscated settler vehicles and opened a police investigation.

top.title: Man charged with arson after setting himself on fire in NYC Google building
top.description: John Butch, 63, allegedly used lighter fluid to self-immolate Friday in the lobby of a Lower Manhattan building housing Google and NYPD offices.

top.title: DHS deports pro-deportation commentator Yiannopoulos to UK
top.description: The far-right British provocateur, who called for ICE checkpoints and mass deportations, was himself removed after overstaying his visa since 2019.

top.title: Crockett declines to campaign with Talarico in Texas Senate race
top.description: The congresswoman told CNN she will focus on down-ballot candidates, declining to join the Democratic nominee who defeated her in the March primary.

top.title: NPS endorses Trump's arch despite harm to 36 DC landmarks
top.description: A 133-page report found the proposed 250-foot gilded arch would disrupt sightlines across Washington but called its Memorial Circle site irreplaceable.

top.title: Hegseth weighs summoning military leaders to Quantico again
top.description: The defense secretary could use a second large-scale gathering to announce new directives, according to the Wall Street Journal.

top.title: US sanctions Egyptian bank's UAE branches over Iran ties
top.description: Treasury moved to cut Banque Misr's six UAE branches from the U.S. financial system, calling them a "critical node" for Iranian dollar access.

top.title: Judge blocks Trump deportation of pro-Palestinian students
top.description: A federal judge ruled that two immigration law provisions used to target noncitizen students over pro-Palestinian speech violate the First and Fifth Amendments.

top.title: Fed Chair Warsh signals rate hikes may be needed as inflation stays elevated
top.description: In his Jackson Hole debut, Warsh said underlying inflation trends have not "meaningfully improved" and current rates may not be restricting growth.

top.title: Pakistan says it won't comply with US sanctions on Iran
top.description: Islamabad joins Beijing in rejecting Washington's "Operation Economic Outcast," vowing to continue and expand trade with Tehran.

top.title: Trump administration quietly pushing to give Yosemite land to private developer
top.description: A NOTUS investigation found the National Park Service has spent over a year working to cede a strip of parkland to a Nevada real estate firm.

top.title: Norway's King Harald V dies at 89 after weeks in hospital
top.description: Europe's oldest reigning monarch died peacefully Friday morning at Oslo University Hospital after battling a bacterial blood infection.

top.title: Venezuela weighs leaving OPEC as US oil ties deepen
top.description: A founding member of the 65-year-old cartel is in talks with Washington about a departure that would mark the second exit in months.

top.title: Trump asks Supreme Court to allow discharge of transgender troops
top.description: The DOJ filed a petition Friday seeking to overturn lower court rulings that block the Pentagon from removing about 4,200 transgender service members.

top.title: FDA approves updated COVID vaccines targeting XFG variant
top.description: Shots from Moderna, Pfizer-BioNTech, and Novavax-Sanofi are approved for older adults and high-risk individuals ahead of fall.

top.title: New York AG sues last sheriff defying state's ICE ban
top.description: Attorney General Letitia James filed suit Thursday against Rensselaer County's sheriff for refusing to end his office's cooperation agreement with ICE.

top.title: Federal judge blocks Trump's bid to erase hush money conviction for third time
top.description: Judge Hellerstein ruled Trump's presidential immunity arguments were "neither new nor legally sufficient" to move the case to federal court.

top.title: FAA moves to fire two controllers who left early before fatal LaGuardia crash
top.description: Two air traffic controllers departed about an hour before their shifts ended on the night of the deadly March 22 collision.

top.title: OpenAI, Anthropic lead 100+ firms in AI cyber threat warning
top.description: The open letter urges governments and businesses to treat cyber defense as an immediate priority before AI-powered attacks overwhelm critical infrastructure.

top.title: Trump admin drafts rule to block China's remote AI chip access
top.description: The Commerce Department could share the proposed export control with industry groups as early as September, though legal hurdles loom.

top.title: Documents contradict RFK Jr.'s claim Samoa trip was unrelated to vaccines
top.description: Letters show Kennedy wrote Samoa's prime minister proposing to study MMR vaccines before his 2019 visit, despite telling senators the trip had "nothing to do with vaccines."

top.title: Iran war's drain on US weapons stockpiles alarms Asian allies
top.description: Six months into the conflict, dwindling Patriot and Tomahawk missile supplies are raising fears about U.S. readiness for a potential confrontation with China.

top.title: Judge declines to block Trump's new birthright order
top.description: The ruling allows the administration to implement a revised executive order issued after the Supreme Court struck down its earlier attempt.

top.title: Hamas agrees to surrender weapons in historic first, Board of Peace says
top.description: The group accepted a 15-point roadmap for full disarmament and governance transfer, but Israel's rejection has stalled implementation.

top.title: Four EU states urge Brussels to unlock frozen Russian assets for Ukraine
top.description: Sweden, the Netherlands, Spain, and Poland sent a letter calling on the European Commission to restart work on using over €200 billion in frozen Russian funds.

top.title: Judge blocks Pentagon's blacklisting of Anthropic
top.description: The ruling found the Trump administration's supply-chain risk designation violated the AI company's First and Fifth Amendment rights.

top.title: Second tanker hit by projectile in Strait of Hormuz this week
top.description: Qatar's PM heads to Tehran for de-escalation talks as attacks on shipping intensify in the contested waterway six months into the U.S.-Iran war.

top.title: Nvidia agrees to buy Hugging Face for $12.9 billion
top.description: The deal for the open-source AI model platform would be one of the chipmaker's largest acquisitions amid an aggressive dealmaking spree.

top.title: Most people arrested by ICE in July had no criminal record, data shows
top.description: Federal data reveals ICE averaged over 1,580 arrests daily in July, with more than half involving people with no criminal history.

top.title: Secret Service places 3 officials on leave amid misconduct probe
top.description: The agency's communications chief and two colleagues lost their security clearances as the Office of Professional Responsibility investigates undisclosed allegations.

top.title: Haiti gang threatens to kill 50 hostages after Kenscoff massacre
top.description: A gang leader posted a video Wednesday showing captives and warning they would be executed if security forces continue operations.

top.title: Trump DOJ raises doubts about prosecuting Fauci for contempt of Congress
top.description: Administration officials question whether the legal strategy behind the Senate's contempt referral is strong enough to support an indictment.

top.title: Nvidia shares rally after Q2 revenue doubles, topping estimates
top.description: CEO Jensen Huang said AI has reached an "inflection point" as the chipmaker posted $96.2 billion in quarterly revenue and guided above consensus.

top.title: Appeals court rules Rep. McIver must face assault trial
top.description: A divided Third Circuit panel found the Speech or Debate Clause does not shield McIver from charges tied to a confrontation at a Newark detention facility.

top.title: Trump admin proposes treating billion-dollar firms as small businesses
top.description: The rule would raise size thresholds dramatically, allowing companies with up to $1 billion in revenue to access federal contracts and loans reserved for small firms.

top.title: FDA approves first drug targeting genetic driver of pancreatic cancer
top.description: Rasonque, made by Revolution Medicines, nearly doubled survival time in trials and was approved 6.5 months ahead of schedule.

top.title: DHS admits its noncitizen voter roll figures were inflated
top.description: After claiming nearly 16,000 noncitizens were on Nevada's rolls, DHS provided a list of just 185 and declined to share supporting data.

top.title: Cook's lawyer says no grounds for Trump to fire Fed governor
top.description: Attorney Abbe David Lowell called mortgage fraud allegations "unfounded and untrue" in a letter sent to the White House on Wednesday.

top.title: Bill Gates warns 'there is no plan' for AI upheaval in new essay
top.description: The Microsoft co-founder calls for global regulation, new institutions and an AI tax, warning of mass job loss and rising security threats.

top.title: Same-name challenger advances to Alaska Senate general election
top.description: Dan J. Sullivan, a retired teacher, secured a spot alongside incumbent Sen. Dan Sullivan and Democrat Mary Peltola in November's ranked-choice contest.

top.title: DeSantis calls Flock cameras 'out of control' amid bipartisan revolt
top.description: Over 100 cities have dropped Flock Safety's license plate readers as lawmakers push federal legislation to curb AI-powered surveillance.

top.title: Trump says Iran's Khamenei alive but 'very seriously wounded'
top.description: The president offered his most detailed assessment of the Iranian Supreme Leader, who has not been seen publicly since the February strikes that killed his father.

top.title: Dolly Parton, queen of country music, dies at 80
top.description: The singer-songwriter, actress and entrepreneur who rose from rural Tennessee poverty to global stardom died Tuesday, her family said.

top.title: Anthropic to pitch $30T market opportunity ahead of IPO
top.description: The Claude maker is preparing to tell investors its addressable market exceeds $30 trillion as it targets an October listing valued at $2 trillion.

top.title: Trump administration pauses visa appointments worldwide
top.description: The State Department cited a "global training initiative" for consular officers, days after a judge struck down a 75-country visa ban.

top.title: China vows to fight back after US sanctions Chinese entities over Iran ties
top.description: Beijing warned it will take "all necessary measures" to protect its interests after Washington sanctioned over 60 entities in its "Operation Economic Outcast" campaign.

top.title: Ukraine stages world's first drone-only military parade
top.description: Unmanned ground vehicles, naval drones, and aerial systems replaced soldiers on Kyiv's streets to mark 35 years of independence.

top.title: Darline Graham wins SC GOP Senate runoff, validating Trump endorsement
top.description: Graham defeated Rep. Ralph Norman on Tuesday despite debate gaffe concerns, and will face a Democrat in November as the heavy favorite.

top.title: US declines to join 50-nation UN rebuke of Russia over Ukraine strikes
top.description: Washington again broke with allies, calling on "both sides" to negotiate instead of condemning Russian aggression at a Security Council session.

top.title: Grocers sue NYC over city-run supermarket plan
top.description: The Multicultural Business Coalition filed two lawsuits Monday to block Mayor Mamdani's $70 million plan for five government-owned grocery stores.

top.title: Trump sends Saudi nuclear deal to Congress, ties it to Israel recognition
top.description: The 30-year pact, reached in July, would allow U.S. exports of civilian nuclear technology to the kingdom, including AP1000 reactors.

top.title: EU approves $7.1 billion in defense aid for Ukraine
top.description: The funding, announced on Ukraine's Independence Day, targets air defense systems, missiles, ammunition, and radars as Russian aerial attacks intensify.

top.title: Iran threatens fines, detention for ships violating Hormuz transit rules
top.description: The warning from Tehran's new maritime authority escalates tensions as the U.S. prepares to roll out sweeping new sanctions against Iran on Monday.

top.title: US intel warned Trump killing Khamenei would backfire, WSJ reports
top.description: Six months into the Iran conflict, a Wall Street Journal investigation reveals intelligence officials cautioned Trump the operation could empower a more extreme regime.

top.title: Florida start-up making low-cost drone interceptors for the Iran war
top.description: Powerus is producing its Guardian interceptor locally in the Emirates to fill gaps in allied air defenses as the U.S.-Iran war drains American-made stockpiles.

top.title: Over 200 Chinese vessels mass near Philippine reef as Beijing announces live-fire drills
top.description: Satellite imagery shows fishing boats in militia-like formations at Mischief Reef, raising fears of a move on Second Thomas Shoal.

top.title: Nevada sues to block Trump administration's Colorado River cuts
top.description: The lawsuit, the first legal challenge to the plan finalized Friday, alleges cuts of up to 71% to Nevada's allocation could devastate Las Vegas.

top.title: Zelenskyy denies Ukraine role in Nord Stream blasts
top.description: The Ukrainian president spoke after a second Ukrainian suspect was arrested in Croatia over the 2022 pipeline sabotage.

top.title: Syria set to leave U.S. terrorism sponsor list after 47 years
top.description: Congress's 45-day review period expired Saturday without opposition, clearing the way for formal removal pending Federal Register publication.

top.title: Trump plans to revoke 200,000 visas from asylum seekers
top.description: The move would be the largest single visa revocation in U.S. history, targeting those who entered on tourist or business visas.

top.title: Iran urges Qatar to move detained pilots to hospital on land
top.description: Tehran claims the airmen are being held on water in poor condition, but Qatar denies holding any surviving pilots.

top.title: FDA urges recall of alfalfa sprouts tied to E. coli outbreak in 15 states
top.description: At least 55 people have been sickened and four hospitalized in a dual E. coli and salmonella outbreak linked to a Minnesota sprout grower.

top.title: Trump threatens to double tariffs on Canadian autos to 50% in January
top.description: The announcement escalates a trade war with Ottawa days after bilateral negotiations collapsed, with Canada vowing to retaliate "dollar for dollar."

top.title: Supreme Court lets White House ballroom construction continue
top.description: Chief Justice Roberts froze a lower court order that would have halted the $400 million project at midnight, buying time for the justices to review the case.

top.title: Cuba says US sanctions undercut the economic reforms Washington long demanded
top.description: Havana's UN ambassador questioned why Washington keeps escalating penalties even as Cuba opens its economy to private investment and foreign business.

top.title: Trump disclosure reveals 1,000 stock trades in June
top.description: A filing released Friday shows the president sold Meta shares and bought Berkshire Hathaway amid a broad portfolio reshuffling.

top.title: NATO's eastern allies offer to cover US base costs amid troop review
top.description: Frontline states are preparing a cost-sharing bid ahead of a meeting with a Pentagon official next week, hoping to keep American forces in the region.

top.title: Texas court cuts Alex Jones' Sandy Hook verdict from $50M to $1.5M
top.description: The appeals court found the trial judge improperly let damages exceed the state's $750,000 statutory cap on exemplary damages.

top.title: Trump warns Democrats will impeach him if GOP loses midterms
top.description: At a South Carolina rally Friday, the president urged Republicans to treat November's elections as a referendum on his presidency.

top.title: Vance says US moving up to 15M barrels daily through Hormuz despite Iran blockade
top.description: The vice president said a military-protected shipping corridor is preventing the energy crisis Iran is trying to create.

top.title: New York Times ordered to pay $9.25M in landmark defamation verdict
top.description: An Alabama jury found the Times defamed former walk-on player Kai Spears, marking the paper's first U.S. defamation trial loss in over 50 years.

top.title: Trump administration dismisses a dozen Fannie Mae executives
top.description: Several top officials, including the chief economist and multifamily COO, were fired Wednesday as AI was cited as a factor in the cuts.

top.title: Hong Kong convicts Tiananmen vigil leaders of subversion
top.description: Lee Cheuk-yan and Chow Hang-tung were found guilty of inciting subversion for advocating an end to one-party rule in China. They face up to 10 years in prison.

top.title: Somali pirates seize 2 ships in 4 days as hijackings hit decade high
top.description: Six ships and over 100 crew members are now held captive as naval forces stretched by Middle East conflicts leave Somali waters less patrolled.

top.title: Trump moves to block BBC subpoenas of family in $10B suit
top.description: Lawyers argue the BBC's bid to compel testimony from Ivanka Trump, Donald Trump Jr. and Jared Kushner is a "politically charged" fishing expedition.

top.title: Wahab wins California special election despite AIPAC spending
top.description: State Sen. Aisha Wahab defeated Melissa Hernandez to fill Rep. Eric Swalwell's vacated House seat, overcoming millions in outside spending.

top.title: FBI arrests woman in ISIS-inspired plot to bomb N.Y. Capitol
top.description: Jessica Bowie, 35, of Albany was charged with planning to deploy an explosive at the state Capitol to kill lawmakers, the DOJ said.

top.title: Trump threatens $5B lawsuit against think tank over National Guard report
top.description: CAP CEO Neera Tanden called the threatened defamation suit "baseless" and said the organization would "neither cower nor bend."

top.title: Seven nations urge Israel to withdraw E1 settlement tenders
top.description: The UK summoned Israel's chargé d'affaires and joined six other Western governments in calling the West Bank construction plan "unacceptable."

top.title: China builds 'unprecedented' maritime presence east of Taiwan
top.description: A new AMTI report says Beijing deployed law enforcement ships and hailed nearly 200 commercial vessels in the Philippine Sea since June.

top.title: Trump administration plans $725M payment toward UN debt
top.description: The transfer covers less than 20% of the more than $4 billion the UN says Washington owes, according to Reuters.

top.title: FBI raids Swalwell's home, seizes devices in misconduct probe
top.description: Agents executed search warrants at San Francisco's airport and his D.C. residence over the weekend as part of a federal sexual assault investigation.

top.title: Bessent says Treasury buybacks could top $4B per operation
top.description: The Treasury secretary signaled further expansion of bond repurchases a day after doubling the program, citing "very poor" liquidity in long-term debt.

top.title: Pentagon fires Stars and Stripes editor and publisher
top.description: The dismissals follow months of clashes over the Trump administration's efforts to exert control over the military's independent newspaper.

top.title: Romania destroys explosive sea drone near major Black Sea gas platform
top.description: EU chief von der Leyen called the incident "hybrid warfare" as Romania's president blamed Russia for escalating threats to critical energy infrastructure.

top.title: Evergrande founder sentenced to life in prison by Chinese court
top.description: Hui Ka Yan was convicted on eight charges including fraud and embezzlement after the property giant's $300 billion default shook China's economy.

top.title: US, Japan, South Korea hold urgent talks after North Korean missile barrage
top.description: Senior diplomats coordinated their response Friday after Pyongyang fired about 10 ballistic missiles, dismissing Trump's scaled-back military drills.

top.title: Army phases out drone battalion in Hegseth-backed shift
top.description: The cutting-edge unit, established in Europe in January to master drone warfare lessons from Ukraine, will revert to conventional airborne infantry.

top.title: US envoy warns Israel-Turkey nearly reached direct military confrontation over Syria strike
top.description: Tom Barrack said Turkish forces were unaware of incoming Israeli jets and could have scrambled fighters, risking a dangerous escalation.

top.title: White House furor over Natalie Harp intensifies after week of damaging leaks
top.description: A pointed remark by Sen. Jon Ossoff about Trump's ever-present aide spiraled into a national story after the West Wing's aggressive pushback backfired.

top.title: Harry and Meghan moving back to Britain after 6 years
top.description: The couple's children are enrolled in a British school starting in September, with the family relocating to a private home outside London.

top.title: Ousted defense chief Fedorov calls for wartime elections in biggest challenge to Zelenskyy
top.description: Once a close Zelenskyy ally, Mykhailo Fedorov cited a "systemic crisis of governance" and condemned corruption in a nine-minute YouTube address.

top.title: Trump admin moves to strip ABA of law school accreditation power
top.description: The Education Department is beginning formal proceedings to revoke the ABA's authority as the sole accreditor of the nation's law schools.

top.title: Germany condemns Ben-Gvir, drops opposition to EU sanctions
top.description: Berlin had previously blocked EU sanctions against the Israeli minister but now backs action after his call for nightly killings in Gaza.

top.title: Merck, Moderna mRNA cancer vaccine succeeds in Phase 3 trial
top.description: Intismeran, a personalized mRNA therapy, reduced melanoma recurrence when added to Keytruda, marking the first positive Phase 3 result for a neoantigen cancer treatment.

top.title: Trump withholds mandated 2024 election interference report
top.description: The administration has released hundreds of pages of other declassified material while keeping the congressionally required foreign interference assessment secret.

top.title: Unitree Robotics surges 460% in Shanghai debut
top.description: China's first publicly traded humanoid robot maker closed its first day of trading at 845 yuan, up from an IPO price of 150.8 yuan.

top.title: Ex-Fauci adviser pleads guilty to concealing COVID-19 records
top.description: David Morens admitted to conspiring to evade public records laws tied to pandemic research grants, including efforts to revive a controversial bat coronavirus grant.

top.title: Navy weighs renaming carrier honoring Black WWII hero after Trump
top.description: The Ford-class carrier CVN-81, designated USS Doris Miller during Trump's first term, may become the first carrier named for a sitting president.

top.title: Florida primaries oust Rep. Mills, advance Trump-backed newcomers
top.description: Redrawn congressional maps reshaped Tuesday's races, with an ethics-plagued incumbent falling and first-time candidates winning key GOP nominations.

top.title: US sanctions ICC president in latest bid to dismantle court
top.description: Secretary of State Rubio called the ICC "corrupt and fatally politicized" as Washington targeted the court's top judge and a senior trial lawyer.

top.title: Trump joins Michael Cohen's radio show in public reunion
top.description: Cohen, the star witness in Trump's 2024 hush money trial, hosted the president on his WABC program after months of quiet reconciliation.
